description: Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen - Movimiento de pasajeros al mes de septiembre 2024 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Número de pasajeros que han transitado de enero a septiembre de 2024, clasificados en entrada, salida y en transferencia. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Its tags are aviación, estadística de pasajeros, pasajeros desembarcados, pasajeros embarcados, trafico pasajeros. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
